name: jpai-delivery
description: Delivery planning from jpeak.ai: gap-analysis planning that iteratively refines a tiered spec covering execution plan, gaps, decisions, and success and negative measures (plan-gap), paired with single-question decision consolidation that self-answers from existing decision records before asking (concise-decisions). Ships the PreToolUse working-agreements coaching hook. Skills are mirrored from the canonical skills/ tree by scripts/sync_plugins.py, so a pack can never drift from the copy it was built from.

interface.shortDescription: Gap-analysis planning paired with single-question decision consolidation
interface.longDescription: The delivery-planning half of the jpeak.ai skill set. plan-gap runs a gap analysis as a tiered spec — an index plus per-gap, per-ticket and discovery files, or a GitHub issue with per-gap sub-issues — covering Execution Plan, Overview, Gap Analysis, Decisions, Success Measures and Negative Measures, validating Mermaid diagrams and enforcing requirement integrity through structured questioning. concise-decisions is its decision surface: it self-answers from existing decision records, then puts the single highest-leverage remaining question with a full briefing and captures the user's reasoning as a reusable lens. A PreToolUse hook turns blocked tool calls into coaching redirects. Both skills are mirrored from the canonical skills/ tree by scripts/sync_plugins.py, so a pack can never drift from the copy it was built from.
